ja: 私たちが気づいたときには、サーバーはもう2時間止まっていました。
en: By the time we noticed, the server had already been down for two hours.
alternatives: When we noticed, the server had already been down for two hours.
The server had already been down for two hours when we noticed.
point: 気づく前から続いていた状態は had been で表す

ja: 昨日のうちに私たちがバックアップを確認していたら、顧客データを失わずに済んだのに。
en: If we had checked the backups yesterday, we wouldn't have lost any customer data.
alternatives: Had we checked the backups yesterday, we wouldn't have lost any customer data.
If we'd verified the backups yesterday, no customer data would have been lost.
point: 過去の後悔は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have 過去分詞

ja: 今はサーバーを再起動しないでください。
en: Please don't restart the server right now.
alternatives: Don't restart the server right now, please.
Please don't restart the server for now.
point: 否定の命令は Don't＋動詞の原形

ja: 決済 API に依存しているサービスは、どれも今もエラーを返しています。
en: All the services depending on the payment API are still returning errors.
alternatives: Every service that depends on the payment API is still returning errors.
All the services relying on the payment API are still throwing errors.
point: 「〜に依存している」は depending on で名詞の後ろから修飾

ja: 昨夜はユーザーが30分ほどログインできませんでした。
en: Users couldn't log in for about thirty minutes last night.
alternatives: Last night, users weren't able to log in for about thirty minutes.
Users couldn't sign in for about 30 minutes last night.
point: 過去の「できなかった」は couldn't、期間は for で

ja: 私たちがまだ分かっていないのは、なぜ監視アラートが鳴らなかったのかということです。
en: What we still don't know is why the monitoring alert didn't go off.
alternatives: We still don't know why the monitoring alert didn't go off.
What we haven't figured out yet is why the monitoring alert never fired.
point: why 以下は疑問文の語順にしない。「鳴る」は go off

ja: ログイン画面でエラーが出ています。
en: There is an error on the login page.
alternatives: There's an error on the login screen.
The login screen is showing an error.
point: 一つのエラーは There is an error。an を忘れない

ja: この障害、影響を受けているのは日本のユーザーだけです。
en: Only users in Japan are affected by this outage.
alternatives: This outage only affects users in Japan.
This outage is only affecting users in Japan.
point: 「影響を受けている」は are affected by で表す

ja: 開発チームはもう障害の原因を特定しましたか？
en: Has the dev team identified the cause of the outage yet?
alternatives: Has the development team found the cause of the outage yet?
Has the dev team figured out what caused the outage yet?
point: 疑問文の「もう」は already ではなく yet を文末に

ja: まずサーバーのログを確認しましょう。
en: Let's check the server logs first.
alternatives: First, let's check the server logs.
Let's look at the server logs first.
point: 提案は Let's＋動詞の原形。logs は複数形

ja: 昨日の夜、サーバーが 2 時間止まりました。
en: The server went down for two hours last night.
alternatives: The server was down for two hours last night.
The server was offline for two hours last night.
point: 「止まった」は went down。過去の出来事なので過去形

ja: うちのチームは、本番に出す前に負荷テストをもう少し長く回しておくべきだったと思います。
en: I think we should have run the load test a bit longer before we pushed to production.
alternatives: I think our team should have run the load test longer before going to production.
We should've let the load test run a little longer before deploying to production, I think.
point: 過去の後悔は should have + 過去分詞（run は run のまま）

ja: 再発防止策を金曜日までにまとめてもらえますか？
en: Could you write up the preventive measures by Friday?
alternatives: Can you write up the preventive measures by Friday?
Could you put together a plan to prevent this by Friday?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Could you。「までに」は by Friday
